contexts.text: That he alone governs the universe.
The Lord as a King governs each and all things in the universe from Divine truth; and as a Priest from Divine good.
The Lord governs the least singulars.
The Lord who would govern the universal Heaven...
Truth governing in a state of temptations. Signified.
It rules and governs the thoughts... Sometimes the truth which governs is not presented conspicuously before the understanding, but... still it governs...
It is the affection of this truth through which the Lord governs those who are in temptations.
Truth through which he can be governed...
God the Creator and Governor of the universe...
Every pilot () = the highest of the laity, who are emperors, kings, dukes, and princes.
Like navigation in a great ocean without a rudder.
That the universe is governed by the Lord very easily...
If they were not governed by the Lord alone...
He was received among others as a governor.
They said that with them he governs who is able to govern...
They who teach, lead, and rule, are meant by the pilot, etc. ().
Every pilot... By the pilot or shipmaster are signified those who are in wisdom.
